definitions.explanation: Drops of liquid from the eyes when crying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嬉|うれ}しくて→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧{涙|なみだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなかった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I was so happy that I couldn't stop crying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ていたら→見る：00283_miru⟧、{涙|なみだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てしまった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I ended up crying while watching the movie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{涙|なみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}している→流す：01968_nagasu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Many people were in tears after hearing the sad news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧や⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{辛|つら}くて→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧、⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧まい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧{涙|なみだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなかった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: At the graduation ceremony, saying goodbye to teachers and friends was so hard that I couldn't hold back my tears even though I tried not to cry.

notes:
{涙|なみだ} means tears—the liquid that flows from the eyes when crying or due to irritation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {涙|なみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to shed tears
- {涙|なみだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: tears come out
- {涙|なみだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: can't stop crying
- {涙|なみだ}⟦もろい→脆い：06069_moroi⟧: easily moved to tears
- {涙|なみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧: to wipe away tears

TYPES OF TEARS:
- ⟦{嬉|うれ}し→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧{涙|なみだ}: tears of joy
- ⟦{悔|くや}し→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧{涙|なみだ}: tears of frustration

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{涙声|なみだごえ}→涙声：19563_namidagoe⟧: tearful voice
- ⟦{涙目|なみだめ}→涙目：27794_namidame⟧: teary eyes
- ⟦{涙腺|るいせん}→涙腺：26029_ruisen⟧: tear glands (lacrimal glands)
